svg.title: Thyroid function pathway: TSH case-finds and free T4 confirms; hypothyroidism splits into primary (Hashimoto's), subclinical and central by TSH and free T4; thyrotoxicosis splits on radioactive iodine uptake into Graves, toxic nodules and thyroiditis or exogenous hormone, plus subclinical hyperthyroidism; each column gives causes and clues, tests and treatment

svg.text: Thyroid function: TSH case-finds, free T4 (± T3) confirms

svg.text: primary disease is commonest: TSH moves OPPOSITE the hormone

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: central disease is the trap: TSH moves WITH it, or not at all

svg.text: THYROTOXIC: too much thyroid hormone, from any cause

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: TSH ↓ · up to 1.5% · female 5 : 1 · hyperthyroidism = from PRODUCTION

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: COLD intolerance · weight GAIN despite ↓ appetite

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: fatigue, slow mentation, apathy, depression · constipation · cool, pale skin

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: bradycardia · diastolic hypertension, NARROW pulse pressure · ↓ cardiac output

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: slow RELAXATION of the reflexes · short of breath, heart failure

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: HEAT intolerance, sweating · weight LOSS despite ↑ appetite

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: hyperactivity, insomnia, anxiety, emotional lability · hyperdefecation · soft, warm skin · TREMOR

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: tachycardia · WIDE pulse pressure · ↑ cardiac output · palpitations · heart failure

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: eyes in ANY thyrotoxicosis: stare, lid retraction, lid lag

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: urgent: storm / instability (Graves) · high-output failure · visual loss · mental health crisis

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Confirm (repeat ↓TSH + ↑FT4 + ↑FT3), then: is the gland MAKING it or LEAKING it?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: RAI uptake + scan: the best single test for the cause · 2-day test · expensive · NOT in pregnancy

svg.text: • personal or family autoimmune disease · Down or Turner syndrome

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • previous thyroid disease or therapy · drugs · pregnancy

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • suspected pituitary or hypothalamic disease: add FT4

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • rare: central HYPERthyroidism, TSH ↔/↑ with FT4 ↑

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • methimazole first for GRAVES: it can remit

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • RAI first for toxic ADENOMA or TMNG, and Graves without remission

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • surgery rarely: large symptomatic goiter · suspected cancer · can't take drugs in pregnancy ·

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • supportive care for everyone: beta-blocker for palpitations, tachycardia, tremor

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Wolff-Chaikoff: a normal gland CUTS production under an iodine load, then escapes

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • subclinical Hashimoto's may not escape → HYPOthyroid

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Jod-Basedow: autonomous nodules or mild Graves use the iodine → HYPERthyroid

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • case: rapid atrial fibrillation 2 days after cardiac catheterization · diffuse goiter · TSH < 0.01,
